checklistTemplate: Confirm 8-passenger BENCH (lower trims) vs 7-seat captain's chairs (top trims)
Run the VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls and confirm all recalls are closed
Palisade: check the dipstick for oil consumption + test all screens (same as the Telluride)
Ascent: check the CVT for shudder; confirm fluid service + any early-build TSBs done
Pilot: feel the 9-speed auto (2016-2018) for harsh shifts; test idle-stop + infotainment
Confirm AWD vs FWD if AWD matters (Subaru is always AWD; Honda/Hyundai optional)
Sit a car seat in the 2nd row and test 3rd-row access with it installed
Measure cargo behind the 3rd row for the stroller/gear
Brakes, 12V battery age, and fluid/service records
Show the credit union 4.99% pre-approval; make them beat it

knownIssues.palisadeOilAndScreens: Palisade = Telluride underneath: 3.8L V6 oil consumption as it ages and screen/cluster failures. Same checks apply.
knownIssues.ascentCvt: Early Ascents had CVT and oil/spark-plug TSBs; some report CVT shudder. Confirm fluid service and updates, and feel for it on the drive.
knownIssues.pilotTransmission: 2016-2018 Pilots with the 9-speed auto drew complaints for harsh/hesitant shifting; idle-stop and the knob-less infotainment also annoy owners. The 6-speed (lower trims) is smoother.
knownIssues.eightSeatTrap: Across all three, the true 8-seat bench lives in the base/mid trims — top trims swap to 7-seat captain's chairs.
knownIssues.recallsAllModels: Every model: run the VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls before buying and confirm completed work.
